process_area.title: B2B Project Escrow Onboarding, Contract Matching & Credit Setup

value_stream.name: B2B Project Financing, Escrow Account Orchestration & Lien Release

fields.Frequency: Continuous per new developer project onboarding
fields.Participants: Developer Finance Director, Escrow Bank Agent, Legal (VS-100), AR Specialist
fields.Trigger: New B2B developer account contract negotiation (VS-11)

workflows.name: Developer Bank-Escrow Agreement Review, Onboarding & Credit Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Digital contract template parsing and credit score mapping.
Controls: - CTL-773 (ensure controlled execution — B2B Project Escrow Onboarding, Contract Matching & Credit Setup (PA-181.1).)
- CTL-773: Escrow agreements legal-approved; credit limit setup complies with Board Risk policy.
Cross-references: - links to VS-11 (trade project), VS-100 (legal), VS-16 (O2C)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Vague release clauses**: Escrow bank agent delays payments due to ambiguous milestone definitions; mitigated by requiring standard bank-release formats before credit approval.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Credit master (VS-16), Legal document portal (VS-100), B2B CRM (VS-11).

steps.activity: Collect and review the tripartite Escrow Agreement / Trust Agreement signed by the Developer, the Funding Bank (Escrow Agent), and the General Contractor.
Verify the escrow funding rules: verify payment release triggers, billing documentation checklists, and inspector audit schedules.
Set up the Developer Project Account in the ERP credit master; configure credit limits and payment terms matching the escrow release windows.
Onboard bank escrow contacts and set up secure communication protocols.

fields.Participants: Developer Procurement Manager, Pricing Specialist (VS-01.2), Master Data Team (VS-29)
fields.Trigger: Developer project onboarding (W5201); contract agreement signed

workflows.name: Project Purchase Order Matching & Contract Price Alignment

Automation Opportunity: - Excel-to-ERP contract price uploader and validation scripts.
Controls: - CTL-773 (ensure controlled execution — B2B Project Escrow Onboarding, Contract Matching & Credit Setup (PA-181.1).)
- CTL-773: Contract prices verified by Category Manager; system blocks billing price changes.
Cross-references: - links to VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-29 (master data), VS-11 (trade project)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Pricing mismatch / Billing rejection**: Wrong prices on billing invoices causing bank to reject the escrow draw; mitigated by automated pricing lock at the project master.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Pricing database (VS-01.2), ERP Master Data (VS-29), B2B CRM.

steps.activity: Upload the developer's Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and contracted unit pricing sheets into the ERP project pricing master.
Configure contract price locks in the system: ensure only the contracted SKUs can be billed to the project code at the negotiated price.
Set up price validation rules: prevent sales clerks from modifying project prices without Category Manager approval (W1394).
Match developer's corporate PO to the BuildRight contract code; verify SKU codes match.

fields.Participants: General Contractor Site Engineer, S&OP Planner (VS-127), DC Manager (VS-04)

workflows.name: B2B Project Materials Requirements Forecasting & Staging Plan

Automation Opportunity: - System-generated staging alarms 30 days prior to scheduled delivery date.
Controls: - CTL-773 (ensure controlled execution — B2B Project Escrow Onboarding, Contract Matching & Credit Setup (PA-181.1).)
- CTL-773: Project staging allocation approved by Inventory Controller; inventory locks tagged with project codes.
Cross-references: - links to VS-127 (S&OP), VS-77 (construction staging), VS-04 (DC ops)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inventory stockout / Project delay**: Critical project items out of stock when needed; mitigated by pre-booking factory production capacity 60 days ahead.
System Touchpoints: - ERP S&OP module (VS-127), WMS staging zone (VS-77), DC inventory master (VS-04).

steps.activity: Review developer's construction timeline and material delivery schedule (e.g. concrete rebar for Month 1, tiles for Month 6).
Generate project-specific material requirements forecast (in SKUs and volumes).
Draft the Staging Plan: schedule warehouse allocation locks at nearest DC to reserve stock for upcoming project phases (VS-77).
Review staging plans monthly; adjust forecast based on construction progress reports.

workflows.name: Bank Escrow Financing Trust Account System Mapping

Automation Opportunity: - MT940 automatic bank statement parsing and cash application proposal.
Controls: - CTL-773 (ensure controlled execution — B2B Project Escrow Onboarding, Contract Matching & Credit Setup (PA-181.1).)
- CTL-773: Account mappings verified by Controller; bank reconciliations performed daily.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Co-mingling of project funds**: Payments applied to wrong project accounts, violating trust covenants; mitigated by automated system validation of project identifier tags on bank wires.
System Touchpoints: - ERP GL (VS-17.1), Treasury Cash module (VS-18), bank system host.

steps.activity: Verify the bank trust account numbers and escrow routing codes with the funding bank.
Map the trust account codes in the ERP General Ledger: set up dedicated subsidiary ledgers for each project's escrow account.
Configure automatic bank statement feed (MT940/BAI2 formats) to track trust account balances.
Test system integration: run sample transaction to verify automatic matching of deposit notifications to the project trust ledger.

fields.Participants: Finance Controller, CFO, B2B Sales VP
fields.Trigger: Project onboarding (W5201); temporary spike in material delivery schedule

workflows.name: Project Credit Limit Allocation & Temporary Excess Approval

Automation Opportunity: - Automated system credit checks blocking orders when limit exceeded.
Controls: - CTL-773: Temporary excess requires dual signature authorization; audit logs of credit limit modifications reviewed monthly.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Developer default**: Exceeding credit limit for developers with unfunded escrow accounts; mitigated by requiring bank certificate of deposit before excess approvals.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Credit management screen (VS-16), GL accounts receivable (VS-17.1).

steps.activity: Calculate base project credit limit: estimate monthly delivery volumes × 2 months (standard credit window).
Route credit proposal through hierarchy approval queue: Credit Manager up to CFO (depending on project size).
Assess temporary credit excess requests: if developer requests peak deliveries exceeding credit limit (e.g. bulk steel delivery), verify the escrow trust account balance holds sufficient funds.
Approve temporary credit excess in ERP with 30-day auto-expiry limits.

fields.Participants: Escrow Bank Agent, Legal Operations (VS-100), Developer Finance Team
fields.Trigger: First credit release request; quarterly credit reviews

workflows.name: Developer Project Escrow Funding Verification & Collateral Assessment

Controls: - CTL-773: Credit renewals blocked if bank escrow balance falls below 1.5× outstanding AR; risk reports shared with CFO.
Cross-references: - links to VS-68 (trade credit), VS-100 (legal), VS-116 (performance bonds)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Underfunded escrow**: Developer fails to deposit equity, blocking bank payouts; mitigated by monthly escrow balance audits.
System Touchpoints: - Credit risk portal (VS-68), Legal documents database (VS-100), bank systems.

steps.activity: Request official Certificate of Escrow Balance from the funding bank.
Verify that developer has deposited the required project equity and bank loan releases into the trust account.
Assess project collateral: review chattel mortgages, bank guarantees (VS-116), or corporate parent guarantees submitted.
Generate project risk assessment report; update developer's risk tier classification (W1394) in ERP.

fields.Participants: Bank IT Team, ERP Systems Admin (VS-27), Document Control (VS-88)
fields.Trigger: Project onboarding (W5201); IT integration project cycle (VS-30)

workflows.name: Escrow Bank Agent Communication Protocols & Portal Integrations

Automation Opportunity: - Automated billing document transmission to bank portal upon delivery receipt scan.
Controls: - CTL-773 (ensure controlled execution — B2B Project Escrow Onboarding, Contract Matching & Credit Setup (PA-181.1).)
- CTL-773: IT security audit approval obtained before API integration; data transmission logs reviewed daily.
Cross-references: - links to VS-113 (enterprise architecture), VS-27 (IT), VS-88 (document control), VS-30 (innovation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data transmission failure / Security breach**: Financial records exposed or delayed; mitigated by HTTPS encryption and automated system status alarms.
System Touchpoints: - ERP integration portal (VS-113), IT security logs (VS-27), document library (VS-88).

steps.activity: Analyze bank's escrow portal API endpoints and security protocols (sFTP, HTTPS).
Develop secure data interface: automate the secure transfer of billing invoices, delivery receipts, and geodetic site photos directly to the bank's portal.
Configure automated email alerts: notify B2B AR team when bank agent uploads inspector approvals or logs draw declines.
Test system integration: run end-to-end data transfer simulations and secure sign-offs.

workflows.name: Project Onboarding Compliance Check (Anti-Money Laundering & Sanctions)

Automation Opportunity: - API-based automatic screening against Dow Jones / World-Check databases.
Controls: - CTL-773: Account setup blocked in ERP without AMLCO digital signature clearance.
Cross-references: - links to VS-86 (anti-financial crime), VS-88 (document control), VS-100 (legal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Regulatory penalty**: Doing business with sanctioned entities or handling money-laundering funds, violating BSP/AMLC rules; mitigated by automated daily screen updates.
System Touchpoints: - Sanctions screening portal (VS-86), KYC documents archive (VS-88), AML audit logs.

steps.activity: Conduct PEP (Politically Exposed Persons) and sanctions screening on the developer corporation, major shareholders, and board directors.
Verify beneficial ownership (KYC): identify and audit owners holding > 10% equity.
Perform source-of-funds check: verify the funding bank's license and check for any regulatory alerts on the project funding source.
Secure AMLCO clearance; file clean-status report in compliance folder before account activation.
